# Wuhan University School of Electrical and Automation Engineering

> Official portal for Wuhan University's School of Electrical and Automation Engineering, providing information on academic programs, faculty, research, and student services.

The School of Electrical and Automation Engineering (EEA) at Wuhan University, established in 1934, is a leading engineering school offering undergraduate and graduate programs in electrical engineering and automation. The site serves as the primary information hub for prospective students, current students, faculty, and the broader academic community.

## Key Topics

- Electrical Engineering
- Automation Engineering

- Graduate Programs
